title: Buddha's teaching of four more inhabited Earth-like planets

tellings.quote: As the great Buddha wrote 2,600 years ago, in our solar system, there are four more planets similar to planet Earth where practically the same exact people live

plain: There are four more planets in our solar system like Earth, where practically the same people live, as the Buddha wrote 2,600 years ago, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, the former president of a republic in Russia who says he was taken by aliens in 1997. He offers it as an ancient teaching. If true, it would mean we are far from alone even close to home.
